name: 50897-sharedprefix-qwen35-27b-tp4
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (four GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. The draft head is a layer of the target and is sharded with it.
architecture: 64 decoder layers, 16 full attention interleaved with 48 gated-delta-net linear attention at `full_attention_interval` 4; 24 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 256, hidden 5120, vocab 248320, `mamba_ssm_dtype` float32.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 64, bounded at 320 requests with a 2700 s safety cap, warmup the first 20% by completion. Read the scored population off `request_latency.successful.count` rather than by subtracting the warmup count.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, one prefix bucket (bucket_weight 100, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 1200); prompt exactly 300 tokens and output exactly 500, so every request is 1200 shared + 300 unique and generates 500. `request_format: plain` applies no chat template, sampling is greedy (`temperature: 0.0`), and the backend forces `ignore_eos` when max_tokens is set, so the run emits 160000 output tokens.
purpose: A 27-billion-parameter writing assistant drafting 500-token replies for 64 concurrent users sharing a long standing prompt, on four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B

# INLINE JSON ON ONE LINE. A declaration is read line by line and indented lines are skipped, so
# re-writing this as a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts with no speculative
# decoding, at rc=0, with nothing in the log to say so.
speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 1}

enable-prefix-caching: true
mamba-cache-mode: align
tensor-parallel-size: 4
max-model-len: 2400
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
